name: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd
title: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd - 522275 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 orders INR86.1bn (+188% YoY) and backlog INR214.6bn (+49%) with EBITDA margin 27.2%, but management guides only to mid-20s margins and capacity adds run through 2028.

capex.quote: we initiated significant capital investment of more than INR10 billion across multiple product lines and facilities

triggers.label: Q4 orders INR86.1bn, +188% YoY
triggers.quote: we saw a booking of INR86.1 billion, up by 188% year -on-year

triggers.label: Capex >INR10bn through 2028
triggers.quote: self -fund our recently announced more than INR10 billion of capex program, which will expand our manufacturing capacity throughout 2028
triggers.highlight: more than INR10 billion of capex program

triggers.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 27.2%
triggers.quote: During the fourth quarter, we achieved a record EBITDA margin of 27.2%

triggers.label: Margin guide mid-20s, not raised
